## Download

**Ledge-VERSION.pkg**: one installer for every Mac, Apple silicon and Intel alike. Or **Ledge-VERSION.zip** if you'd rather drag the app into Applications yourself. Needs macOS 13 Ventura or later. Under 1 MB.

## Install

1. Open the `.pkg` and follow the steps: **Continue**, **Install**, then enter your Mac password.
2. Ledge opens by itself when it's done. Look for its icon in the menu bar, then hover over the notch.

**The first time, macOS may say it can't verify the installer.** Ledge is free and not signed with a paid Apple certificate. **Right-click** the `.pkg` (or the app) → **Open** → **Open**. No Open button? Try once, then go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security** → **Open Anyway**.

**Updating:** run the new installer. It quits Ledge first, and what's on your Shelf is kept.

Prefer to build it yourself? See the [README](https://github.com/Tech-Reign-Era-Services/ledge#build).
